summary: Usage-limit deferrals are never capped and deferred rows are requeuable; dossier entry added under lean.md

amendments.why: Intentional: #4784 makes rate_limited uncapped, so the base batch.test.mjs asserts that flip (deferred-codes cap/gap sequence at the rate_limited deferral, and the #4528 capped-codes list that includes rate_limited); both are updated in this change. Against the merge base 14f3a633c only those 2 base subtests fail; the other failures against the staging tip come from tests of features that landed after this branch forked (#4791, #4787, #4788, #4920) and are not touched by this change.
